our_interpretation: The supplied claim combines historical assertions with explicitly qualified judgments about staffing and scientific significance.

For reviewing the historical background, interpret 'the last few years' as approximately 2022 through the January 6, 2026 post. The start is an evaluator convention, not an exact date Marcus supplied.
Do not turn 'don’t seem earth-shaking' into an objective benchmark threshold or a claim that no useful results existed.
Do not equate paper authorship with dedicated project staffing.
The firm-language plain-reading exception does not apply to these qualified significance judgments. Checkable background facts cannot settle the entire supplied proposition.
criteria.support_condition: The historical components could be supported by dated research and staffing records. The complete claim has no fair support test because the speaker supplies no objective standard for his qualified judgment about significance.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records could contradict particular historical components. Benchmark gains, released models or robot demonstrations alone would not contradict the qualified judgment that the papers do not seem earth-shaking.
